autoDiscover.title: Auto discover
autoDiscover.description: Scan your local network for Modern Forms fans at startup. Turn off to use only the fans listed below.

pollingInterval.title: Status check interval (seconds)
pollingInterval.description: How often to check each fan's state, so changes made with the remote or the Modern Forms app show up in the Home app. Set to 0 to turn off.

fans.title: Fans
fans.description: (optional) Fans are discovered automatically. List a fan here if it isn't found, or to hide its light.

light.title: Has a light
light.description: Turn off for fans without a light kit, to hide the light tile.
